name: Head of Gath'Ilzogg
summary: Claiming Gath'Ilzogg's severed head proves the Blackrock warlord has been slain. His fall breaks the leadership behind the siege of Stonewatch Keep and brings desperate relief to Lakeshire.

sections.title: A Bountied Warlord
sections.body: Gath'Ilzogg led the Blackrock assault that took Stonewatch Keep, drove out its defenders, and left the valley under constant raids. Lakeshire stood near ruin, while Stormwind sent almost no military help. Magistrate Solomon offered a bounty on the warlord. Gath'Ilzogg fell in the keep's fortified upper levels, and claiming his head breaks the local Blackrock leadership. For Lakeshire, it is the first step toward reclaiming the keep for the kingdom.

faq.answer: Gath'Ilzogg was a powerful Blackrock orc warlord who led the conquest of Stonewatch Keep and directed raids against settlements in Redridge Mountains, bringing Lakeshire close to collapse.

faq.q: Where is the head taken once collected?
faq.answer: The head goes to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire's town hall, as proof that the bounty on the town's wanted board has been fulfilled.

faq.q: What does Gath'Ilzogg's death mean for Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Gath'Ilzogg's death deprives the Blackrock invaders of their chief tactician in Redridge. Many Blackrock orcs remain entrenched across Stonewatch, but the break in their command gives the local defense a chance to hold the region.
Gath'Ilzogg occupied the high reaches of Stonewatch Keep, deep within the captured fortification with his personal bodyguards and lieutenants.

angles.text: For Stormwind's people, bringing down Gath'Ilzogg avenges the slaughter of innocent settlers and the humiliating fall of Stonewatch Keep.
With the capital distracted by internal squabbles, Alliance volunteers must defend Redridge and strike down Blackrock leaders themselves.
